name: Orbitdesk
summary: A customer support help desk where SLA timers tick and change colour, and tickets orbit their agent
about: A nine-page help desk for the support team of an e-bike subscription company. Every open ticket carries an SLA timer that ticks down and turns from teal to amber to red, and the overview shows each agent's open tickets circling them on three rings, the inner ring being the most urgent. The inbox, ticket view with macros and internal notes, customers, knowledge base editor, automations with a flow canvas, reports, team and settings all work and keep their data in the browser.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Overview, Inbox, Customers, Knowledge, Automations, Reports, Team or Settings
On the overview, pick an agent to see their tickets orbit them; switch the rings between due time and priority
In the inbox, filter by view, queue, priority, channel or agent, select tickets to assign or solve them in bulk
Open a ticket, insert a macro or an article, reply or add an internal note, and change status, priority or assignee
Edit and publish help articles, switch automation rules on and off, add steps and press Test run
Change the date range on Reports, set SLA targets in Settings and watch every timer follow
Press Ctrl+K to jump to any page, ticket, customer or article, and reset the demo data in Settings
